title: Plumeform button (v2)
description: Pill buttons and an underlined link. Solid is foreground-coloured (ink on paper, paper on the dark bands) and turns plume teal (mint on dark) on hover with a 1px lift; soft is a quiet bordered pill; link is bold text with a 2px teal underline and a separately underlined arrow.
notes: solid follows the foreground colour, so it flips between ink and paper with the dark class
name: plumeform-v2-button

props.name: href
props.description: where it goes; without it the button is a <button>

props.name: variant
props.description: solid pill (foreground colour), soft bordered pill, or an underlined text link

props.name: arrow
props.description: show an arrow after the label

props.name: block
props.description: stretch to the width of its container

props.name: type
props.description: for a <button>: the form button type
